items.title: Jerry Coker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 18, 2023
items.q: They reacted to it very much the same way we did. At first it was a little too much, you wondered what he was doing and that sort of thing.

ctx.x: Yeah. Right. And my father played — continued to play a long time after his youth. So it was close to it and so when my brother and I grew up and we started playing our records, he got interested in what records we were listening to, and he kept up with us very well and so did my mother. They came to hear us play when they could.
What did your father or mother think of Charlie Parker?
